ev.q: players take on the roles of "survivors" and "traitors"
Project Winter is a social deduction video game featuring survival game mechanics
Players must observe their health, heat, and hunger bars
The game also uses a crafting system as an alternative to scavenging
The survivors must search the map for bunkers and similar structures
In order to win, the survivors must locate and repair two objectives and call for help within 30 minutes
the balancing act of wilderness survival, social deduction, puzzle solving and team communication can roll into an overwhelming blur
